title: Python unsigned link parser aliases entire body as MIC
description: LichenFrame.from_bytes computes mic = body[len(body)-mic_len:] even when mic_len is zero. Because -0 is 0, every unsigned frame receives the complete body as frame.mic; payload parsing happens to work, but the parsed object violates its invariants and cannot serialize round-trip. Return b'' explicitly for unsigned frames and add boundary/round-trip coverage.
close_reason: Invalid review finding: len(body) - mic_len evaluates to len(body) when mic_len is zero, so the slice is empty as intended. Manual reproducer and all 16 signed/unsigned round-trip cases pass; no source change required.
